title: Domri Rade | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about Domri Rade, the Planeswalker with an affinity for wild beasts in Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Domri's affinity for wild creatures grew out of his natural distrust of rules, hierarchies, and authority figures. He can weave magic that summons, commands, and enhances these beasts. As leader of the Gruul on Ravnica, Domri revels in chaos and destruction.
